statement: One line holds a string s of lowercase letters. Print its border array (lps), space-separated: entry i is the length of the longest proper prefix of s[0..i] that is also its suffix. Build it in one pass with a running border length: on a match with s[len] extend by one; on a mismatch fall back to lps[len - 1] and retry - the chain of borders of borders - reaching 0 at worst. This array is the engine inside KMP pattern search.

example.why: At position 5 the border aab fails to extend, falls back to a, and regrows - entry 2.

hint: Values rise by at most 1 per step and the first entry is always 0 - two instant sanity checks.
mistake: Zeroing the border on mismatch instead of following the fallback chain; nested borders vanish.
